song_ids=set(); page=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for it in resp:
        song_ids.add(it['song_id'])
    page+=1
print('song_ids count:', len(song_ids))

# from album library
album_song_ids=set(); page=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for alb in resp:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids', []):
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page+=1
print('album_song_ids count:', len(album_song_ids))

# from playlist library
playlist_song_ids=set(); page=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for pl in resp:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page+=1
print('playlist_song_ids count:', len(playlist_song_ids))

all_song_ids = song_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print('unique union song_ids count:', len(all_song_ids))
print('min/max ids:', min(all_song_ids), max(all_song_ids))

# fetch song details and find oldest by release_date
from datetime import datetime

oldest=None
oldest_candidates=[]
for i, sid in enumerate(sorted(all_song_ids)):
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd=s.get('release_date')
    # normalize release_date parse
    # expected format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS
    try:
        dt=datetime.fromisoformat(rd)
    except Exception:
        # if rd is None or not parseable, skip
        print('unparseable release_date for sid', sid, 'rd', rd)
        continue
    rec=(dt, sid, s.get('title'), s.get('album_title'), [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', [])])
    if oldest is None or dt < oldest[0]:
        oldest=rec
        oldest_candidates=[rec]
    elif dt==oldest[0]:
        oldest_candidates.append(rec)
    if i<5 or i==len(all_song_ids)-1:
        print('checked sid', sid, 'release_date', rd, 'title', s.get('title'))

print('oldest release_date:', oldest[0].isoformat(), 'sid', oldest[1])
print('oldest title candidates:', [(c[2], c[3], c[4]) for c in oldest_candidates])
